name: Agent Memory Integrity
description: Agent Memory Integrity: a conformance test suite that measures whether AI agent memory and checkpoint stores notice tampering. Measured on LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, OpenClaw, Hermes, Letta, Mem0, Vertex AI Memory Bank and the integrity tools that claim tamper evidence. IETF draft-khandelwal-bmwg-agent-memory-integrity.
